note: Each pass: rows [token, pos, slot]; logits are those of logit_rows, in order; keep and taken are read after feed. tau null is the reference's one-fill-per-pass mode. reference_decode_forwards is llm_engine's count, which leaves out the finishing pass.

scenarios.name: defaults
scenarios.what: W 16, tau 0.4, lambda 0.02 (the reference's defaults); several fills per pass; ends on a stop token committed mid-window, with filled tokens after it

scenarios.name: one_at_a_time
scenarios.what: W 4, tau None (one fill per pass, the paper's quality setting); a one-token prompt; argmin ties broken by distance; ends on max_new_tokens

scenarios.name: max_mid_commit
scenarios.what: W 8, tau 0.6, lambda 0.05; the max_new_tokens limit falls inside one pass's commit, so the commit is cut short; passes that fill exactly one

scenarios.name: aggressive
scenarios.what: W 8, tau 0.9, lambda 0.05; a fully filled window (2W rows in one pass); the model predicts the MASK id itself, which is committed as an ordinary token

scenarios.name: exact_ties
scenarios.what: W 6, tau None, lambda 0; mask rows with bit-identical logits, so the lowest adjusted entropy is an exact tie and the first such mask must win
